system.description:
Requires «Reactive Mastery» to use. You can not use «Reactive Heal», but gain +[«Reactive Mastery»'s SR × 5] to a damage roll you do. This effect lasts until the end of the round.

A special skill that diverts the magical power of reaction activation recovery and increases the power by enveloping it in a weapon. However, it is necessary to be careful that the original recovery effect cannot be used.
